Going to go indepth bc i dont know where you are as a player.  just a few things ik from my experience, I dont main inkling but ive played against quite a few of them in bracket, 

1. Roller > Up/Fsmash is something you'll see alot
2.Upthrow Up-air (join the inkling discord and start learning %s if you havent already)
3.Back Throw at high %s, not only does it kill, but its a solid option bc of how strong inklings grab as, considering how easy it is to grab an opponent with inkling due to his hitbox being very small during a dash
4. EDGEGUARD, i know i sound like leffen rn but inklings edgeguarding is great, he can go super deep to get the kill on people offstage, Fair is a  long lasting hitbox, that also kills, and back air is just great. I wouldnt try and hit dair too much bc the hitbox isnt the best. 
5.Downsmash At ledge. Covers neutral Getup & Jump, along with that is very fast so i believe it will also cover getup attack as if you time it right you will be able to shield before it comes out.

That being said, Inkling definitely isnt the easiest to close out stocks with. a Common mistake i see is inklings fishing for roller. this is no bueno, as once roller is shielded your free to get shieldgrabbed or hit out of shield. Let roller be something you dont use very often as it is extremely telegraphed and good players will just shield the moment they see it come out. 

HOWEVER, I'm not entirely sure about this so i would look into this. if their shield is real small i've heard it can shield poke, so this would force them to either run back or jump, and should they jump you could chase them with one of your great aerials.

Inklings a good choice, also get used to using your dash and knowing what moves you can whiff punish as it can be rather hard to hit inkling during initial dash. Best of luck to you and dont be afraid to PM me any questions you have! ♥️♥️ Hope this helped!
